post.description: Authenticates a user using either password-based authentication or OAuth authentication. **Password authentication**: Set grant_type to password and provide username and password. **OAuth authentication**: Set grant_type to oauth and provide a valid OAuth JWT token in the request header using the Authorization scheme: Authorization: Bearer <token>. Username and password are not required for OAuth authentication.

parameters.name: grant_type
parameters.description: Specifies the authentication method. Use password for username/password authentication. Use oauth for OAuth authentication (requires Authorization header with Bearer token).

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Email address of the user. **Required only when grant_type is password**. Not required for OAuth authentication. (Use guest@boldreports.com for this demo API)

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password of the user. **Required only when grant_type is password**. Not required for OAuth authentication. (Use Guest123@BoldReports! for this demo API)

post.summary: Add user(s) to the particular group
